name: Boys & Girls Club of Greenwich Summer Camps
description_short: The Boys & Girls Club of Greenwich runs three summer camps: Clubhouse Camp (ages 6-12) at its Horseneck Lane clubhouse, Camp Simmons (ages 6-12) on 77 wooded acres on Lake Avenue, and Teen Camp (ages 13-15), plus a Counselor-in-Training program. You must be a current BGCG member to register.
swim_waterfront_notes: Clubhouse Camp has a 25-meter pool and offers swim lessons. Camp Simmons has an outdoor swimming pool and a pond used for fishing and canoeing. Teen campers can use the swimming pool.
